title: Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045)

verified.machine: Windows 10 Home 22H2 (Core), AMD64, Intel i7-2600K 8 logical CPUs, 32 GB RAM, 2 SATA SSD + 3 USB disks, NVIDIA GPU

etw.session_flags_note: One kernel session; flags ORed: PROCESS|THREAD via Thread provider, FILE_IO 0x02000000 | FILE_IO_INIT 0x04000000 | DISK_FILE_IO 0x200, DISK_IO, DPC 0x20 | INTERRUPT 0x40
etw.disk_response_time_unit_assumed: 100 ns (equal to a QPC tick on this machine; latencies of 70-260 us on SATA SSD look plausible, not independently verified)

quirks: FileIo name events (opcodes 0, 36) never arrived in a live session; names come from Create (op64) OpenPath, and from the system handle table for files opened before the trace.
FileIo Read/Write IoSize is the REQUESTED size; the transferred size is OperationEnd (op76) ExtraInfo matched by IrpPtr.
FileObject addresses are recycled after Close (op66); resolve names when each event arrives.

A flush (FlushFileBuffers/sync_all) makes the cache manager write the pages as paging I/O credited to the CALLING process; counted as application writes it doubled a 64 MiB write to 128 MiB. Paging requests (IoFlags & 0x42) are excluded from per-process and per-file figures.
Reading to the end of a file completes with STATUS_END_OF_FILE (0xC0000011); that is not a failed request.
Some disk requests cannot be tied to a thread/process; they carry pid 0xFFFFFFFF, shown as '(unknown process)'.
Live ETW self-tests (collector startup, ~2.5 s) write and read back an 8 MiB file and require it to be measured within bounds; all four passed on this build.
DPC/ISR InitialTime is a raw QPC tick count; header timestamps are only comparable when the trace requests raw timestamps (vendored ferrisetw patch).
Some DPC events have InitialTime = 0, giving a duration equal to time since boot; durations over 1 s are dropped.
SystemMemoryListInformation (class 80) needs SeProfileSingleProcessPrivilege; free+zero+standby matched PhysicalAvailable to within 1 MB.
Unelevated process lists under-report working sets of protected processes by roughly 2.4 GB on this machine.
ETW DPC total was within about 14-27% of the Windows '% DPC Time' counter and ISR within about 27% (collector low); not exact.
